caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a lamp base. It is rendered in grayscale pencil, with careful shading that gives the object a three-dimensional appearance. The lamp base has a broad, circular foot that tapers upward into a narrower neck, and then flares out again into a rounded, segmented central body. The upper section features a socket-like structure with a ridged, rectangular opening at the very top. The surface of the object is smooth and its various sections are defined by shaded bands and gradations of tone, emphasizing the contours. The background is plain, with no additional objects or decorations; the drawing occupies the central area of the paper. Text at the bottom left of the drawing reads "LAMP 80 -" and in the bottom right corner there is a name, "Amelia Tuccio."
title: Lamp
